meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: Claude 会去查 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库,按「搜索→时间线→取详情」三步走:先返回带 ID 的索引表,筛掉无关项后再批量取完整记录,以减少 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当你问起之前的会话而非当前对话时触发,例如「这个问题之前解决过吗」「上次 X 是怎么做的」「上周发生了什么」等。

say.text: 帮我搜一下之前的会话里有没有解决过认证超时的问题
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 上次这个项目的 token 过期是怎么修的?取一下 #10942 的完整记录
say.note: 只对筛出的 ID 取完整详情

say.text: 看看上周这个项目都发生了什么
say.note: 按日期范围搜索观察记录

howto.what_en: Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory database with a search → timeline → fetch workflow: it returns an index table with IDs first, then batch-fetches full records only for the filtered IDs to save tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions rather than the current conversation, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?"

say_en.text: Search past sessions for whether we already solved the auth timeout issue
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs first

say_en.text: How did we fix token expiration last time? Fetch #10942
say_en.note: Fetches full details only for filtered IDs

say_en.text: What happened in this project last week?
